id.description: The name of the chat session file of Claude Code, or the identifier of the chat session of Codex.

title.description: The title, or the first message of the developer when the chat session has no title.

firstRecordAt.description: The date of the first record that has a date.

lastRecordAt.description: The date of the last record that has a date.

updatedAt.description: The date of the last change of the chat session file.

userMessageCount.description: The number of messages that the developer typed.

folder.description: The root folder of the workspace whose chat session list holds the chat session: the folder where the coding agent started it.

firstMessages.description: The text of the first messages that the developer typed, at most three of them, each one on one line.

tokens.description: The tokens of the chat session, for each model. A request without a known model has the model name empty.
